chapter: Glaser, the Arcadia and bands of 1939-41
title: Prince Robinson
summary: Roy praises clarinetist Prince Robinson, who played the Albert system.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: And you know who was a helluva musician and a helluva clarinet player, he never really got any recognition in later years, was Prince Robinson.
Oh, he was marvelous. People don't even know
how much he played, man, you know? And he played the Albert system, too.

Yeah. This is the one that's the hard one to play! He was a good tenor player, too. You know, at one time it was, like, Coleman and Prince Robinson. That's when the big Cotton Pickers was goin', you know.
